name: figure01_candidate_distributions
caption: All 9,377,010 valid original pixels per band. Transparent 65535 values are excluded. No candidate values exceed 1; this is a plausibility observation, not proof that calibration was applied.

name: figure02_candidate_spectra
caption: Three fixed native source pixels, positive alpha. Candidate A is 1.99996948 times the DN/65535 numerical fraction. Shape, spectral angle, correlations and ratio indices cannot establish the absolute physical scale.

name: figure03_candidate_maps
caption: Maps are decimated only for display; native statistics use all valid source pixels. Correlations use a deterministic approximately 50,000-pixel sample and are unchanged by a common positive divisor. No calibrated reference/panel observation is supplied.
